note: Advisor CONTENT is scripted; the fan-out driver, lease/heartbeat, filesystem projection, Chair consolidation, and persisted report are the real release artifacts. The shipped defect was an orchestration deadlock on a hung lens, not an advisor's output.

scenarios.title: Complete cycle to the review gate
asserts: the cycle reaches the reviewable state
a report is printed AND persisted
five lenses plus the Chair are present

scenarios.title: A single lens stalls past its budget
asserts: the stalled lens terminates not_evaluated with a governed reason
the other four lenses' results are durably recorded on disk
the lease is renewed by the heartbeat while the lens hangs
the cycle still reaches Chair and a persisted report
scenarios.productionIncident: One lens hung for ~600s while four completed analyses were never recorded and then lost; the pre-driver fan-out deadlocked on Promise.all.

scenarios.title: Terminate a live cycle and resume it
asserts: resume never re-dispatches an already-recorded role
the resumed cycle completes with every role present

scenarios.title: Large monorepo with a gitignored .planr
asserts: a real cycle runs inside a large monorepo
git check-ignore .planr succeeds
.planr is never staged for commit

scenarios.title: No internal transport in the human transcript
asserts: no lease token appears outside the --json evidence log
no stdin JSON payload appears outside the --json evidence log
no evidence digest appears outside the --json evidence log
no harness or adapter command name appears outside the --json evidence log

scenarios.title: No cross-runtime process or asset
asserts: the run produces no asset bound to a runtime other than the sticky runtime

scenarios.title: Only planr on PATH
asserts: the packed CLI drives operate with only planr on PATH

scenarios.title: Parallel native subagents; same-runtime sequential fallback
asserts: a native-parallel runtime fans out in parallel
a runtime without native parallel dispatch falls back to same-runtime sequential
no cross-runtime fallback occurs

scenarios.title: Full real-native-agent cycle per runtime
asserts: a complete Operate cycle reaches the review gate driven by a real Claude Code subagent
a complete Operate cycle reaches the review gate driven by a real Codex subagent
a complete Operate cycle reaches the review gate driven by a real Cursor subagent
scenarios.reason: Requires runtime credentials and the published packed artifact.
scenarios.runWith: workflow_dispatch input live_advisor_dispatch=true with the runtime credentials configured as secrets
